findings.message: Incomplete Round-trip. `_byhour()` only runs in the final `else` branch of the weekly text generation, so weekday rules don't print their hour. The parser now accepts `every weekday at 10` and sets `byhour`, but `toText()` still returns "every weekday" and drops "at 10". The same happens for rules that hit the `isEveryDay` branch. Moving the `byhour` handling after the whole if/else chain would cover every weekly case.

Convertibility Check. Weekly rules can now carry `byhour` from parsing and rendering. If the weekly entry in the `IMPLEMENTED` table still lacks `byhour` (it is commonly only listed for DAILY), `isFullyConvertible()` will return false for rules like `every week on monday at 10`. Callers that check convertibility before calling `toText()` would then skip text they can now render. This table is outside the diff, so please verify it.

Missing Tests. This PR adds new grammar paths: `AT()` after weekday, week, and named-day rules. It adds no tests for strings like `every weekday at 9`, `every week on monday at 10`, or `every tuesday, thursday at 8`, and none for their `toText()` round-trip. Without them, regressions such as the dropped weekday hour described above go unnoticed.
